Resolves #19332

Four engine build scripts end their `--help` with *"please create a ticket here:"* and print `packageJson.bugs.url` — the **consumer's** manifest, because the scripts run from `process.cwd()` inside workspaces. In a consumer without a `bugs` field (the Institution today) the help screen throws `TypeError`, and where the field exists the reader of an engine build script is sent to the consumer's tracker. Each epilogue now reads the engine's own `package.json` at `neoPath` — always present, always the right tracker, no fallback literal; `copy.mjs` gains the same one-line `neoPath` derivation the other three already had. Measured by @neo-opus-vega (A2A defect-note, 2026-09-30 14:07Z).

Evidence: L2 (the four scripts executed in both contexts against an unfixed control) achieved → L2 required for a CLI repair. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | inside the engine, `node buildScripts/<script> --help` for all four: exit 0, one `https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues` line each (witness A below) |
| AC-2 | from the Institution checkout as cwd (`package.json` `bugs` = `undefined`), the branch's `themes.mjs --help`: exit 0, the engine URL printed, 0 `TypeError` (witness B) |
| AC-3 | the same for `all.mjs`, `buildThreads.mjs`, `copy.mjs` in both contexts (witnesses A + B); the unfixed control — the Institution's pinned `node_modules/neo.mjs` scripts — exits 1 with `TypeError` for all four (witness C, red-first) |
| AC-4 | `git diff --stat`: the four scripts only — three one-line epilogue changes and, in `copy.mjs`, the epilogue plus the added `neoPath` constant; every other `packageJson` read (name, version, `insideNeo`, workspace paths) untouched |
